subject.title: feat(workspace): lint and auto-fix code fences in markdown at write time

question: Should OpenClaw add Markdown code-fence hygiene to workspace file writes, and if so should it be default auto-fix, warn/doctor-only, opt-in, or outside the core write path?
rationale: The request changes write semantics for user-authored workspace files and adds config/API surface; prior implementation attempts were closed unmerged after correctness concerns, so the right default cannot be selected from source inspection alone.

options.title: Require warn or opt-in design first
options.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer-approved design avoids silent default mutation and proves parser safety against nested fence examples.

options.title: Approve default auto-fix
options.body: Allow a future PR to rewrite workspace Markdown on write by default, with parser-backed tests, config docs, and upgrade/proof coverage.

options.title: Reject core write-time mutation
options.body: Redirect the idea toward manual docs linting, doctor lint, Skill Workshop guidance, or a plugin/workflow outside core writes.

recommendation.title: Require warn or opt-in design first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a maintainer-approved design avoids silent default mutation and proves parser safety against nested fence examples.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest combined routing signal across agents.files safety, workspace bootstrap history, and product/config policy ownership evidence.
